attchmntText: Ptc Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: PTC Industries Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding a schedule of investor and analyst meetings. The meetings are scheduled to take place between November 30 and December 3, 2026, in Singapore and Hong Kong. The events will include one-on-one and group sessions. The company stated that discussions will be based on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these interactions. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies on the part of the investors or the company. Any revisions to the schedule will be communicated to the stock exchanges. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Ptc Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: PTC Industries Limited has secured a contract from the Indian Defence Sector for the supply of approximately 400 tonnes of Titanium ingots, bars, and rods. The order is to be executed within 12 months. The financial value of the contract is not disclosed due to strategic and confidentiality considerations. The materials are intended for critical defence applications requiring high strength and corrosion resistance. This announcement is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The entity awarding the order is a domestic entity. There are no related party transactions or interests held by promoters in the awarding entity.
